receipt.query: Windows WinFsp native image read-only projection callback mount session persistent inode and source lifetime

conclusions: The pinned SDK permits originating PID queries only during Create/Open and eligible Rename; this guard invokes it only for Create/Open.
The directory mounting branch creates/opens the fresh parent directory before FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT; no live own-namespace read bypass is added.
The guard remains additional lifecycle admission, preserving original authorization, kernel-origin zero and independent CPU storage/recovery.
An initial SDK lookup accidentally addressed strmt7/FlitzFS and returned404. Correct winfsp/winfsp captures, tag resolution and pinned blob/digests followed; no source pin changed.
A passing own-open test does not reconstruct historical kernel state or prevent every inherited/duplicated-handle, indirect backing-cycle, driver or future-bug failure.
